text:
maria: heads-up — nightly attest job flagged 3 miniroot artifacts as failing cosign verification. I pulled the logs and it looks like signature envelopes are missing for those digests.

ashok: ugh. which digests? can you paste the cosign output?

maria: paste below:
```
$ cosign verify --key ksm://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/miniroot/cryptoKeys/signer img:sha256:0a1b2c
Error: verification failed: no matching envelope for signature
```

kevin: that usually means the cosign signatures were produced with a different key id or the KMS signer role was rotated. any recent KMS ops?

ashok: I rotated the signer key yesterday morning as part of the scheduled key hygiene sweep after PR #412. I thought CI would pick up the new key but i did not update the signer service account binding — my bad.

maria: ok that explains it. runtime has been refusing those images in staging?

kevin: staging nodes saw the verification error and fell back to the previous image tag (we keep a 24h fallback window). prod is still on the old image tag for now. we prevented a mass rollout.

audit-bot: AuditEvent: KMSKeyVersionChange project=redwood key=miniroot-signer actor=ashok@redwood time=2026-03-22T03:12:18Z

images-team: plan proposal — two-step: (1) update KMS IAM to give cosign SA the new signer role, re-run verification; (2) re-sign affected artifacts and push a canary tag; roll canary through canary group for 1 hour; then cut full rollout if green.

maria: sounds good. can you paste the exact gcloud command to add the binding?

ashok: sure:
```
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/miniroot/cryptoKeys/signer \
  --member="serviceAccount:cosign@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com" \
  --role="roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeySigner"
```

ashok: after that cosign verify should succeed against the existing signatures if the key version matches. if it still fails we'll re-sign.

kevin: if you re-sign, use the pipeline to avoid human-signed anomalies. Example sign cmd for pipeline (ci agent will use KMS URI):
```
cosign sign --key ksm://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/miniroot/cryptoKeys/signer img:sha256:0a1b2c
```

maria: runtime question — will images already rejected by the verifier be allowed once you update IAM or do we need to re-push?

kevin: once IAM is fixed, cosign verify with the same key material should validate old envelopes. if key version changed such that signatures were produced with previous version, verification still works because cosign embeds the public info; the critical bit is the signer being allowed to sign/verify via KMS policy. if not, we re-sign.

sre-oncall: any chance this caused an incident window for customers?

kevin: no customer impact — staging only. had we let the bad images roll to prod it would've blocked rollout. the guardrail did its job.

ashok: I'm going to: (a) add the IAM binding, (b) trigger nightly attest job manually for the affected digests, (c) open PR documenting the missed step and add a preflight check to CI that verifies IAM bindings before rotation. ETA ~2 hours.

maria: thanks. please paste the job run output here when done and ping @kevin and @sre-oncall.

audit-bot: ActionLog: iam_binding_added actor=ashok@redwood target=projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/miniroot/cryptoKeys/signer time=2026-03-22T05:01:05Z

ashok: done — binding added and attest re-run. verification now passes for the 3 digests.

maria: verified locally as well. canary sign/push queued by pipeline.

images-team: executing canary rollout now, will monitor metrics and attest logs. rolling to 5% first.

sre-oncall: watching. let me know if we need to abort; I have the revert list ready.

maria: recording for postmortem — root cause: key rotation run without corresponding service account RBAC update in CI preflight. remediation: IAM preflight check + runbook update + post-rotation smoke attest.

ashok: PR opened for runbook and CI check (https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pull/789). I'll follow up with timeline for full rollout.

maria: thanks all :thumbsup:
